blocking_findings.actual_layout: Metadata at runtime-v2/; arms at runtime-v2/stage/off and stage/on.
blocking_findings.behavior: No --stage-root choice supplies both required root/stage-plan.json and root/{off,on}. Runner ignores declared case.directory when snapshotting, checking input/namelist and launching.
blocking_findings.remedy: Preserve v2; freeze additive runner using declared case directories consistently, then re-review exact successor pins.

limits: Read-only static source and metadata review; no full asset rehash or scientific process.
Input one-element proof is separately pinned by input-review.json; does not guarantee runtime discriminating activation.
Number field labels are process context, not physical units authority.
No Nc/PSD/population/physical accuracy or forecast relevance approval.
scoped_findings: Stage21 supplies cached CPM/XLV at this one-substep source case; host CP=1004.5, CPV=4*RV, XLV=2.5e6, SVPT0=273.15 and udminit CLIQ-CPV are used.
Qsaturation includes min(es,0.99*P); reported es_Pa is uncapped context, so do not generalize reported ES as actual capped value. At target current P cap is inactive.
Same-step RH>1 plus emitted positive NC_ACT and PC_ACT and source-ordered NN/NC/QV/QC/T updates replace prior all-zero oracle.
One-use, first failure stop, bounded cleanup, immediate terminal RC record before log-close/postflight are present.
Source-table replay is a Python binary32 expression model; no generic compiler intrinsic bit-identity assertion.
